Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, a Stage 1 Pokémon, and a Stage 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Inferno X
text.text: Discard any amount of {R} Energy from among your Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

text.name: Pokémon ex rule
text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Mega Evolution ex Rule
text.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
